about.companyDesc1: Beijing Feichuan Equipment Technology Co., Ltd. is headquartered in Beijing and focuses on industrial UAV systems, airspace monitoring, intelligent inspection, and site-screening technologies.
about.companyDesc2: The company connects engineering development, field deployment experience, and partner resources to support infrastructure operators, utilities, emergency teams, and public-site managers.
about.companyDesc3: We help customers turn sensing, inspection, records, and response coordination into practical operating procedures.
about.rdTeamDesc: Driving innovation with technical expertise and deep industry experience.
about.rdExperience: The core R&D team is led by 10+ senior industry experts, with an average of over 15 years of experience.
about.rdSystemDesc: A reliability design system built based on intelligent industrial standards.
about.uavReliabilityDesc: Adopting redundant flight control architecture, ensuring stable operation of UAVs in complex environments.
about.intelligentAlgoDesc: Technology based on multi-sensor fusion, effectively dealing with various illegal UAV intrusions.
about.aiRecognitionDesc: AI-based image analysis technology, providing comprehensive optical visual system solutions.
